verdict.rationale: Inngest workflows are written as ordinary TypeScript/Python/Go functions with steps, not YAML/DSL, and steps are automatically memoized/checkpointed so execution resumes from the last successful step on failure (inngest-docs-2, inngest-docs-21, inngest-docs-24). Community devs confirm the code-first DX feels natural compared to alternatives like Temporal (inngest-comm-9, inngest-comm-7). Missing for 10: no independent third-party benchmark or deep technical audit of the checkpointing mechanism beyond vendor docs and anecdotal praise.
